biography.value:
Yu lung are carp dragons: great golden koi with dragon heads, who swim upstream for centuries in the hope of one day becoming true lung dragons. Playful and vain, they love praise and shiny things.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .esFLHERF1mLCkJRy]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .H1hL9RcL410vg76x]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .j7TlgkV49moHDxVo]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=USI5bfemKbOOJIBF]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=USI5bfemKbOOJIBF]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=USI5bfemKbOOJIBF]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sweeps its long, serpentine body. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=TjwIcTQCo8wkmf53]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a jet of water in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=CjyzTEY6S2Nng9bP]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=CjyzTEY6S2Nng9bP]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=CjyzTEY6S2Nng9bP]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} flies without wings, riding the air itself. It can't be knocked prone while flying, and its flight isn't affected by magic that would ground a winged creature.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can leap up to 30 feet out of water as part of its movement.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • The water churns; each creature in water within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet.
  • A shimmer of scales dazzles one creature: DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or it is &Reference[charmed] until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Mist rises; the area within 20 feet of the dragon is lightly obscured.
